goal.original: Build the full-clip V2V Foley workflow on the bench - freeze all video, mask all audio, generate no new frames - with the same audio input and audio reference sockets the main ltx_i2v_t2v workflow has.

It has RUN once end to end and produced audio - but the audio was very loud and distorted. Two fixes have landed since and NEITHER has been executed. completed: Workflow authored: 58 nodes, 92 links, zero new node packs, every class present on bench 8188 AND app engine 48188
Mask polarity: LTXVSetAudioVideoMaskByTime with mask_video=false + mask_init_value_video=0.0 freezes every video frame; audio influence rides mask_init_value_audio

Discovered the main workflow's SolidMask -> SetLatentNoiseMask influence pair CANNOT be reused - LTXVSetAudioVideoMaskByTime overwrites av_latent['noise_mask'] (latents.py:826-841), so it would have silently done nothing
No video decode: output muxes the ORIGINAL full-res frames against generated audio, so encode resolution cannot degrade the delivered video
TrimAudioDuration on the input-audio path - LTXVConcatAVLatent only calls fit_audio when the video side is already an AV latent, so a long reference track would otherwise OOM the sampler
Checked against Lightricks' OWN reference (archived at tasks/MPI-4/research/lightricks-foley-v2a-reference.json): architecture agrees node-for-node, all 19 steering parameters match
Foley IC-LoRA downloaded by the user to G:/CubricModels/loras/ltx-2.3/, wired at strength 1.0
FIRST RUN: audio very loud and distorted. Root cause read from /history - AUDIO cfg 6.0 into euler_ancestral_cfg_pp on the distilled int8 checkpoint. Set to 1.0
Resize To Target keep_proportion crop -> resize: crop discarded frame content from an encode that exists only for model comprehension
SECOND+ RUNS: UnboundLocalError noise_pred_neg. Traced to MultimodalGuider at cfg 1.0/1.0. Node 118 (and 121) now use core CFGGuider at cfg 1

Lipsync investigated and the brief's wrong claim corrected: it is NOT a third mask polarity, it is EmptyLTXVLatentVideo + LTXAddVideoICLoRAGuide + LTXVSetAudioRefTokens + ic-lora-lipdub. Its own file, its own op
pending: RUN IT. Open ltx_v2v_foley_template.json on the bench, muted clip in Input_Video, both audio toggles OFF, press Run. Everything below is unproven until this passes

If the audio is still hot: LTXVNormalizingSampler is a drop-in for SamplerCustomAdvanced, audio_normalization_factors default '1,1,0.25,1,1,0.25,1,1' quarters the audio latent at steps 3 and 6 - sized for our 8-step schedule

If foley quality is poor rather than hot: the Foley LoRA was tuned on ltx-2.3-22b-dev with LTXVScheduler 30 steps and plain euler. We run distilled int8 at 8 ManualSigmas steps. Swapping the scheduler is the bigger lever

OPEN UNKNOWN, does not block: what registers a sampler_post_cfg_function when the ref-audio branch is off. LTXVReferenceAudio is ruled out by four history runs; LTX2SamplingPreviewOverride uses add_wrapper_with_key(OUTER_SAMPLE), not a post-cfg hook. A print in multimodal_guider.py line 263 answers it in minutes, and is only needed if MultimodalGuider is ever wanted back

Voice mode is a SEPARATE test from foley mode and they are not simultaneously satisfiable: real path in Input_Audio (it is block_if_empty=true, so an empty string BLOCKS once the toggle executes it), strip 'speech, dialogue, talking, narration' from Input_Negative, and set Foley_Lora to None so the SFX LoRA and the ID LoRA are not stacked
Product decision owed at MPI-520: foley mode and voice mode want different negatives and a different LoRA state. Do not ship both toggles as if they compose

key_decisions: EDIT THE BENCH COPY IN PLACE - NEVER REGENERATE. The user hand-organises node positions to read the graph; all 58 had been repositioned between two edits. Method: GET the userdata copy, mutate only the nodes involved, assert every node's pos/size is unchanged, POST. scratchpad patch_inplace2.py is the shape. build_foley.py is a historical record of how the graph was first derived and must NOT be re-run
Reference audio STAYS in the foley file (user's call) for voice consistency, even though the Foley LoRA is a sound-effects model whose negative suppresses speech

MultimodalGuider is unusable at cfg 1.0 on both modalities - proven over four runs. Core CFGGuider at cfg 1 is the repo's standard for this checkpoint and is what the extend workflow ran when it produced usable foley audio
Input_Width/Input_Height stay as injectable MpiInt: they set the resolution the model SEES, never the delivered pixels. A link on the widget slot would silently kill app injection
constraints: The user owns the bench browser tab and it holds the graph in memory. Ask them to close or reload it before writing to userdata, and re-fetch immediately before every write
Reference frame counts sit on the 8n+1 lattice; the graph derives them so no clip is rejected
